collector_source:
from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import glob
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import time

root = Path.cwd()
evidence = root / 'docs/acceptance/evidence/m3/upstream-transport/upstream-0.21'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
baseline = evidence / 'post-comment-format-source-after.json'
expected = json.loads(baseline.read_text())
before = {f: sha(root / f) for f in expected}
assert before == expected
script = root / '.audit/m3-loaded-identity.exs'
temporary = root / '.audit/m3-loaded-identity.metadata.json'
argv = ['nix', 'develop', '--command', 'elixir', '-pa']
argv.extend(sorted(glob.glob('_build/test/lib/*/ebin')))
argv.extend([str(script), str(temporary)])
environment = os.environ.copy()
environment['ERL_FLAGS'] = '+S 2:2'
start = time.monotonic()
result = subprocess.run(argv, env=environment, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)
after = {f: sha(root / f) for f in expected}
log = evidence / 'h1-loaded-identity.log'
log.write_text(result.stdout + result.stderr)
receipt = {
    'status': 'PASS_POINT_IN_TIME_IDENTITY_ONLY' if result.returncode == 0 and before == after else 'FAIL',
    'observed_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'exit': result.returncode, 'elapsed_seconds': round(time.monotonic()-start, 3),
    'argv': argv, 'ERL_FLAGS': '+S 2:2', 'timeout_seconds': 45,
    'source_snapshot': baseline.name, 'source_snapshot_sha256': sha(baseline),
    'frozen_source_files': len(expected), 'all_source_hashes_unchanged': before == after,
    'changed_source_files': [f for f in expected if before[f] != after[f]],
    'vm_script_sha256': sha(script), 'vm_script': script.read_text(),
    'collector_source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'log': log.name, 'log_sha256': sha(log),
    'sol_repairs': 0, 'sol_unsuccessful_repairs': 0, 'astra_rounds': 0,
    'command_shutdown': 'subprocess.run completed; no peer or background job started',
    'metadata': json.loads(temporary.read_text()) if result.returncode == 0 else None,
    'independent_review': 'PENDING',
}
out = evidence / 'h1-loaded-identity.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr
assert before == after
assert receipt['metadata']['module_count'] == 34
print('PASS point-in-time identity:', receipt['metadata']['module_count'], 'modules;', len(expected), 'stable source hashes; exit', result.returncode)
command_shutdown: subprocess.run completed; no peer or background job started
vm_script:
[output] = System.argv()
started_before = Application.started_applications() |> Enum.map(&elem(&1, 0)) |> Enum.sort()
sha = fn bytes -> :crypto.hash(:sha256, bytes) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower) end

modules = [
  String, Regex, URI, Enum, Keyword,
  HTTP, HTTP.FetchOptions, HTTP.Request, HTTP.HTTP1, HTTP.Headers,
  HTTP.Trailers, HTTP.RequestLifecycle, HTTP.Transport.SSL, HTTP.Transport.TCP,
  HTTP.SocketClient, HTTP.Promise, HTTP.Stream, HTTP.HTTP1.Upload,
  HTTP.ManagedTransport, HTTP.ManagedTransport.Policy, HTTP.ManagedTransport.Scope,
  HTTP.ManagedTransport.Receipt, HTTP.HTTP1.Pool, HTTP.Runtime.Dialer,
  HTTP.Runtime.Options,
  Gaoxy.Proxy.ManagedH1Preparation, Gaoxy.Proxy.ManagedH1Accounting,
  :gen, :gen_server, :ssl, :ssl_gen_statem, :tls_gen_connection,
  :tls_gen_connection_1_3, :public_key
]

records = Enum.map(modules, fn mod ->
  {:module, ^mod} = :code.ensure_loaded(mod)
  path = :code.which(mod) |> List.to_string() |> Path.expand()
  bytes = File.read!(path)
  {:ok, [{^mod, disk_md5}]} = :beam_lib.md5(String.to_charlist(path))
  loaded_md5 = apply(mod, :module_info, [:md5])
  true = loaded_md5 == disk_md5
  compile = apply(mod, :module_info, [:compile])
  {:file, loaded_from} = :code.is_loaded(mod)
  source = case Keyword.get(compile, :source) do
    nil -> nil
    value -> to_string(value)
  end
  %{module: Atom.to_string(mod), beam_path: path, beam_sha256: sha.(bytes),
    loaded_from: to_string(loaded_from), loaded_md5: Base.encode16(loaded_md5, case: :lower),
    disk_code_md5: Base.encode16(disk_md5, case: :lower), code_md5_equal: true,
    compile_source: source, compile_version: to_string(Keyword.fetch!(compile, :version)),
    compile_options: inspect(Keyword.get(compile, :options, []), limit: :infinity),
    source_sha256_now: if(source && File.regular?(source), do: sha.(File.read!(source)), else: nil)}
end)

own_exe = "/proc/" <> System.pid() <> "/exe"
{:ok, exe_target} = File.read_link(own_exe)
exe_sha = sha.(File.read!(own_exe))
true = exe_sha == sha.(File.read!(exe_target))
started_after = Application.started_applications() |> Enum.map(&elem(&1, 0)) |> Enum.sort()
new_started = started_after -- started_before
[] = Enum.filter(new_started, fn app ->
  name = Atom.to_string(app)
  String.starts_with?(name, "gaoxy") or String.starts_with?(name, "http")
end)
options = HTTP.FetchOptions.__struct__()
33 = map_size(options)

receipt = %{status: "PASS_POINT_IN_TIME_IDENTITY_ONLY", observed_utc: DateTime.to_iso8601(DateTime.utc_now()),
  module_count: length(records), modules: records,
  runtime: %{elixir: System.version(), elixir_build: System.build_info(),
    otp_release: to_string(:erlang.system_info(:otp_release)),
    erts: to_string(:erlang.system_info(:version)),
    architecture: to_string(:erlang.system_info(:system_architecture)),
    word_bytes: :erlang.system_info(:wordsize), build_type: :erlang.system_info(:build_type),
    emu_flavor: :erlang.system_info(:emu_flavor),
    c_compiler_used: inspect(:erlang.system_info(:c_compiler_used)),
    dynamic_trace: :erlang.system_info(:dynamic_trace),
    runtime_root: to_string(:code.root_dir()),
    internal_active_n_configured: Application.get_env(:ssl, :internal_active_n),
    own_executable_path: exe_target, own_executable_sha256: exe_sha},
  fetch_options: %{entries_including_struct_key: map_size(options),
    fields: options |> Map.keys() |> Enum.map(&Atom.to_string/1) |> Enum.sort()},
  applications_started_before: Enum.map(started_before, &Atom.to_string/1),
  applications_started_after: Enum.map(started_after, &Atom.to_string/1),
  new_http_or_gaoxy_applications: [],
  scope: "Standalone read-only metadata; no application start, scope, socket, peer or integration",
  limitations: ["Code MD5 is a BEAM code identity, not whole-file or source reproduction proof",
    "Current source hash does not prove it was the compiler input",
    "Own executable hash does not establish native field layout or effective translation-unit macros",
    "Point-in-time module/profile sample is not scope-lifetime enforcement or hot-code exclusion",
    "No P0-P6 activation proof or TLS lifecycle qualification"]}
File.write!(output, JSON.encode!(receipt))
IO.puts("PASS point-in-time identity: #{length(records)} modules; FetchOptions33; no HTTP/Gaoxy app start")
